# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 36 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)

**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 37 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_036_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 36

**1** Jesus said: "Do not worry from morning until evening and from evening until morning about what you will wear."

---

**Consensus Notes (SOPHIA):**

**Coptic vs. P.Oxy 655:** The Coptic version is significantly shorter than P.Oxy 655, which adds food, body-size, and the lilies-of-the-field passage (paralleling Matthew's full passage). SOPHIA translates the Coptic; the P.Oxy extension is noted.

**"From morning until evening and from evening until morning"** — LOGOS/EMET preferred. The double sweep covers all hours. PNEUMA's condensation ("morning to night, night to morning") is natural but slightly loses the formal parallelism.

**Synoptic Parallels:**
- Matt 6:25-34: "Do not be anxious about your life, what you will eat or what you will drink, nor about your body, what you will put on"
- Luke 12:22-31: Same Q passage
- Thomas's Coptic gives only the clothing element; P.Oxy 655 adds food and the lilies passage, bringing it closer to Matthew
